args.Content:
# FINN — Financial Investment Agent

**Product POV:** Filtering, not aggregating. A chief-of-staff mobile-first web application (`390px–430px` viewport) built around the **"Morning Briefing + Command Bar"** interaction model. Every screen answers *"so what?"* in one line using **primary sources only** (official NSE/BSE filings and earnings conference call transcripts). Zero news articles, zero broker notes, zero fabricated data.

---

## Live vs. Cached Components (Transparency Statement)

FINN separates **offline data ingestion & AI extraction** (Python pipeline) from **request-time serving** (Next.js App Router) so the web UI is fast, deterministic, and immune to upstream exchange WAF blocks during evaluation.

| Layer / Feature | Status in Repo | Upstream Primary Source | How It Works |
|---|---|---|---|
| **EOD Prices & Volume-Spike Alerts** (`data/prices/*.json`) | **Real data cached on disk** (refreshed `2026-10-27` via live `yfinance` `1.2.0` across all 18 NSE tickers) | Yahoo Finance (`*.NS`) | [`pipeline/fetch_prices.py`](pipeline/fetch_prices.py) pulls 90-day OHLCV bars, drops partial intraday bars before `16:00 IST`, computes the prior 20-session SMA (`shift(1).rolling(20).mean()`), and applies a **corporate-action guard (`vol_guard`)** that pauses volume alerts when a stock split, bonus, `<20` prior sessions, or `>20%` overnight price gap (e.g., demerger) falls inside the 20-day window. |
| **Results Filing Extraction — Slice 1** (`data/documents/results/*.pdf` → `data/slice1_extractions.json`) | **Real NSE PDFs cached on disk** + extracted via live `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` calls | NSE Corporate Archives (`nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/*.pdf`) | [`pipeline/extract_results.py`](pipeline/extract_results.py) scores pages deterministically (Consolidated over Standalone), detects broken embedded OCR in scanned PDFs (`RELIANCE_Q1FY27.pdf` p. 9, `INFY_Q2FY27.pdf` p. 18, `MARUTI_Q1FY27.pdf` p. 4) and renders those pages to PNG via `pypdfium2`, extracts raw line items in native units (`crore`, `million`, `lakh`), normalises to `₹ crore` in Python, computes Schedule III Operating EBITDA (`"not_applicable"` for banks), and validates `EBITDA < Revenue` and `PAT <= PBT`. |
| **Corporate Announcements Digest & Mgmt Change Enrichment** (`data/announcements/*.json`) | **Real NSE filings cached on disk** (92 announcements across 15 portfolio stocks) | NSE Corporate Announcements API (`www.nseindia.com/api/corporate-announcements`) | BSE (`api.bseindia.com`) blocks automated requests with Akamai `403`. [`pipeline/fetch_announcements.py`](pipeline/fetch_announcements.py) uses `curl_cffi` (`impersonate="chrome"`) against NSE's JSON API, classifies materiality (`1` Material, `2` Notable, `3` Routine/Noise) via `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, and downloads the actual PDF for `management_change` filings (`data/documents/filings/*.pdf`) to extract incoming/outgoing executive backgrounds with page citations. |
| **Pull Mode — "Narrative vs. Numbers"** (`data/research/*.json`) | **Real NSE transcripts + results PDFs cached on disk** for `INFY.NS`, `RELIANCE.NS`, `TCS.NS`, `ICICIBANK.NS`, `ETERNAL.NS`; **CLI runs live for any NSE ticker** | NSE Corporate Archives (`concall_transcript` + `results_filing` PDFs over last 4–5 quarters) | [`pipeline/generate_research.py`](pipeline/generate_research.py) downloads the last 4–5 quarterly earnings call transcripts and financial results PDFs from NSE, extracts text page-by-page (`[DOC_X \| Page N]`), runs `gemini-3.6-flash`, and enforces a **strict Python citation gate**: any `guided` or `delivered` claim whose `(doc_id, page)` was not actually fetched and read is rejected. |
| **Morning Briefing Assembly & Window Selector** (`/`, `/api/digest?hours=...`) | **Live at request time** (`force-dynamic`) | Reads `data/prices/*.json` and `data/announcements/*.json` | [`lib/data.ts`](lib/data.ts) (`getDigest()`) dynamically filters announcements by the selected lookback window (`24h` default, `14d`, `30d`, `120d`), evaluates price/volume alert thresholds from `data/portfolio.json`, and renders honest empty states whenever a window has zero filings. |

---

## Verified Gemini Model Routing (Checked `2026-10-27`)

Model names were verified against `GET https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models` and rate-limit documentation at `https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits` (see [`DECISIONS.md`](DECISIONS.md) `#15`):
- **Bulk classification, summaries, and single-page table/filing extraction**: `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` (fallback `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`) — fast, multimodal PNG support, zero thinking-token overhead.
- **Multi-quarter "Narrative vs. Numbers" synthesis across 8–10 PDFs (~45k–65k input tokens)**: `gemini-3.6-flash` (fallback `gemini-3-flash-preview` / `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`).
- Every LLM call is content-hash cached in `data/.llm_cache/` and logged with exact token counts and cost in [`data/llm_log.json`](data/llm_log.json).

---

## Running Locally

### 1. Web Application (Next.js 15)
```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm start        # Serves production build on http://localhost:3000
# or: npm run dev
```

### 2. Offline Data & AI Pipeline (Python 3.9+)
Create `finn/.env` with `GEMINI_API_KEY=<your_key>` (confirmed gitignored in `.gitignore`).

```bash
pip install -r pipeline/requirements.txt

# 1. Verify all 18 portfolio + ad-hoc tickers against live Yahoo Finance
python3 pipeline/verify_tickers.py

# 2. Fetch 90-day EOD prices + compute 20-day volume ratios with corporate-action guard
python3 pipeline/fetch_prices.py

# 3. Run Slice 1 results PDF extractor (with pypdfium2 vision fallback & validation)
python3 pipeline/extract_results.py

# 4. Fetch, classify & enrich NSE corporate announcements across the 15 portfolio stocks
python3 pipeline/fetch_announcements.py

# 5. Generate "Narrative vs. Numbers" primary-source research for any NSE ticker(s)
python3 pipeline/generate_research.py INFY.NS RELIANCE.NS TCS.NS ICICIBANK.NS ETERNAL.NS
# Or run on any other NSE symbol on demand:
python3 pipeline/generate_research.py TITAN.NS
```

---

## Key Files
- [`DECISIONS.md`](DECISIONS.md) — Architectural, data, and model decisions log (including the transparent correction log from commit `019b139`).
- [`pipeline/extract_results.py`](pipeline/extract_results.py) — Slice 1 results PDF page scorer, `pypdfium2` vision fallback, unit normaliser (`crore`/`million`/`lakh` → `₹ crore`), Schedule III Operating EBITDA calculator, and accounting validator.
- [`pipeline/fetch_announcements.py`](pipeline/fetch_announcements.py) — NSE announcement fetcher (`curl_cffi`), materiality classifier, and `management_change` PDF enricher.
- [`pipeline/generate_research.py`](pipeline/generate_research.py) — Multi-quarter NSE transcript + results PDF fetcher and citation-verified "Narrative vs. Numbers" analyzer.
- [`data/slice1_extractions.json`](data/slice1_extractions.json) — Full raw + normalised extraction output across the 9 test filings.
- [`data/llm_log.json`](data/llm_log.json) — Complete token and cost audit log for every Gemini API call.

def _quote_verified_on_page(
    quote: str,
    doc_id: str,
    page: int,
    read_pages: dict[tuple[str, int], str],
) -> tuple[bool, int]:
    """
    Verify that the substantive words/numbers of `quote` actually appear on
    `(doc_id, page)` (or `page ± 1` if a sentence spans a page break).
    Returns `(is_verified, matched_page)`.
    """
    if not quote or len(quote.strip()) < 5:
        return False, page
    tokens = [
        t.lower()
        for t in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9%.]+", quote)
        if len(t) >= 2
    ]
    if not tokens:
        return False, page

    for candidate_page in (page, page - 1, page + 1):
        page_txt = read_pages.get((doc_id, candidate_page))
        if not page_txt:
            continue
        low_page = page_txt.lower()
        matched = sum(1 for t in tokens if t in low_page)
        if matched / len(tokens) >= 0.65:
            return True, candidate_page
    return False, page

    Enforce the strict citation gate:
    - Reject any `guided` or `delivered` claim if `doc_id` is not in `docs_by_id`
      or `(doc_id, int(page))` is not in `read_pages`.
    - Format `source` deterministically as `<Doc Title>, p. <page> ("<quote>")`.
    """
    stats = {"verified_claims": 0, "rejected_claims": 0}
    verified_quarters: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for q in raw_nvn.get("quarters") or []:
        if not isinstance(q, dict):
            continue
        raw_guided = q.get("guided") or []
        raw_delivered = q.get("delivered") or []

        clean_guided: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        clean_delivered: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        max_len = max(len(raw_guided), len(raw_delivered))
        for i in range(max_len):
            g = raw_guided[i] if i < len(raw_guided) and isinstance(raw_guided[i], dict) else None
            d = raw_delivered[i] if i < len(raw_delivered) and isinstance(raw_delivered[i], dict) else None
            if not g or not d:
                stats["rejected_claims"] += 1
                continue

            g_doc = str(g.get("doc_id") or "").strip()
            d_doc = str(d.get("doc_id") or "").strip()
            try:
                g_page = int(g.get("page"))
                d_page = int(d.get("page"))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                stats["rejected_claims"] += 2
                continue

            if (g_doc, g_page) not in read_pages or g_doc not in docs_by_id:
                print(f"    ❌ REJECTED guided claim: ({g_doc}, p.{g_page}) not in read_pages")
                stats["rejected_claims"] += 1
                continue

            if (d_doc, d_page) not in read_pages or d_doc not in docs_by_id:
                print(f"    ❌ REJECTED delivered claim: ({d_doc}, p.{d_page}) not in read_pages")
                stats["rejected_claims"] += 1
                continue

            g_meta = docs_by_id[g_doc]
            d_meta = docs_by_id[d_doc]
            g_quote = (g.get("quote") or "").strip().replace('"', "'")
            d_quote = (d.get("quote") or "").strip().replace('"', "'")

            g_source = f"{g_meta['title']}, p. {g_page}" + (f' — "{g_quote[:90]}"' if g_quote else "")
            d_source = f"{d_meta['title']}, p. {d_page}" + (f' — "{d_quote[:90]}"' if d_quote else "")

"""
FINN Pipeline — Hardened Citation Gate & Negative Test Suite.

Enforces strict primary-source verification on every "Narrative vs. Numbers"
claim (`guided` and `delivered`):
1. `valid_doc_id`: `doc_id` must exist in the fetched NSE PDF manifest.
2. `exact_page_read`: `(doc_id, page)` must exist in `read_pages` (NO ±1 page
   tolerance — the exact integer page number cited must have been extracted).
3. `contiguous_quote_on_page`: The cited `quote` (after normalising whitespace
   and ellipses `...`) must appear verbatim on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]`.
4. `exact_numbers_on_page`: Every quantitative number (percentage, $, ₹, bps,
   count, multiple) in BOTH `claim_text` (`guidance` or `actual`) AND `quote`
   must appear as an exact number token on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]`
   (including exact decimal digits: e.g. `21.0` is rejected if the page only
   prints `21`, and `3.2%` is rejected if the page prints `3.1%`).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


# Standard non-quantitative tokens in Indian financial filings (quarter/FY labels,
# network generation 5G, business model 1P/3P, segment O2C, field KG-D6).
LABEL_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:Q[1-4]|FY\s*'?\d{2,4}|[12]H|H[12]|5G|4G|1P|3P|O2C|KG-D6|B2B|B2C)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Number pattern capturing integers and decimals (with optional thousand commas)
NUMBER_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])(\d+(?:,\d+)*(?:\.\d+)?)(?![A-Za-z])")


def extract_quantitative_numbers(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """
    Extract all quantitative number strings from `text` after masking out
    quarter/fiscal-year labels (Q1..Q4, FY26, 1H, 5G, 1P, O2C, KG-D6).
    Normalises thousand-separator commas ('72,275' -> '72275') while preserving
    exact decimal digits ('21.0' stays '21.0', NOT '21').
    """
    if not text:
        return []
    masked = LABEL_TOKEN_RE.sub(" ", text)
    raw_nums = NUMBER_TOKEN_RE.findall(masked)
    return [n.replace(",", "") for n in raw_nums]


def _normalise_for_substring(s: str) -> str:
    """Lowercase and collapse runs of whitespace/punctuation to single spaces."""
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9%.]+", " ", s.lower()).strip()


def verify_single_claim(
    claim_text: str,
    quote: str,
    doc_id: str,
    page: Any,
    docs_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    read_pages: dict[tuple[str, int], str],
) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
    """
    Verify a single claim against `docs_by_id` and `read_pages` with ZERO page
    tolerance. Returns `(passed, rejection_reasons)`.
    """
    reasons: list[str] = []

    # 1. Check doc_id exists in fetched manifest
    doc_id_clean = str(doc_id or "").strip()
    if not doc_id_clean or doc_id_clean not in docs_by_id:
        reasons.append(f"invalid_doc_id ({doc_id_clean!r} not in fetched manifest)")
        return False, reasons

    # 2. Check exact page was read (NO ±1 page tolerance)
    try:
        page_int = int(page)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        reasons.append(f"non_integer_page ({page!r})")
        return False, reasons

    if (doc_id_clean, page_int) not in read_pages:
        reasons.append(
            f"page_not_read (({doc_id_clean}, p.{page_int}) not in read_pages; ±1 tolerance disabled)"
        )
        return False, reasons

    page_text = read_pages[(doc_id_clean, page_int)]
    norm_page = _normalise_for_substring(page_text)
    page_numbers = set(extract_quantitative_numbers(page_text))

    # 3. Verbatim quote check on the exact page
    quote_clean = (quote or "").strip()
    if len(quote_clean) < 8:
        reasons.append("quote_too_short_or_missing")
        return False, reasons

    # Split on '...' if the LLM elided middle words, and require every segment to
    # appear as a contiguous normalised substring on `page_text`.
    segments = [
        _normalise_for_substring(seg)
        for seg in re.split(r"\.{2,}|…", quote_clean)
        if len(_normalise_for_substring(seg)) >= 4
    ]
    if not segments:
        reasons.append("quote_empty_after_normalisation")
        return False, reasons

    for seg in segments:
        if seg not in norm_page:
            reasons.append(
                f"quote_not_on_page (segment {seg[:60]!r} not found on {doc_id_clean} p.{page_int})"
            )
            break

    # 4. Every quantitative number in `quote` must appear on the page
    quote_nums = extract_quantitative_numbers(quote_clean)
    missing_quote_nums = [n for n in quote_nums if n not in page_numbers]
    if missing_quote_nums:
        reasons.append(
            f"quote_numbers_missing_on_page ({missing_quote_nums} not on {doc_id_clean} p.{page_int})"
        )

    # 5. Every quantitative number in `claim_text` (guidance/actual) must appear on the page
    claim_nums = extract_quantitative_numbers(claim_text or "")
    missing_claim_nums = [n for n in claim_nums if n not in page_numbers]
    if missing_claim_nums:
        reasons.append(
            f"claim_numbers_missing_on_page ({missing_claim_nums} in claim {claim_text!r} not on {doc_id_clean} p.{page_int})"
        )

    return len(reasons) == 0, reasons


def run_negative_test_suite(
    docs_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    read_pages: dict[tuple[str, int], str],
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Run 10 deliberately corrupted claims against real INFY.NS read_pages.
    All 10 MUST be rejected.
    """
    # Known real reference on INFY.NS:
    # DOC_4 = Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (21-Oct-2025)
    #   p. 2 has: "revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency"
    #   p. 2 has: "The new guidance is growth between 2% and 3% in constant currency terms for the full year."
    #   p. 2 has: "Our operating margin was 21%."
    # DOC_3 = Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026)
    #   p. 4 has: "The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency"
    test_cases = [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "corruption_type": "Wrong page number (p. 15 instead of p. 2)",
            "claim_text": "Q2 FY26 revenue grew 2.2% QoQ and 2.9% YoY in CC terms.",
            "quote": "revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 15,
        },
        {
            "id": 2,
            "corruption_type": "Off-by-one page number (p. 3 instead of p. 2 — tests removal of ±1 page tolerance)",
            "claim_text": "Q2 FY26 revenue grew 2.2% QoQ and 2.9% YoY in CC terms.",
            "quote": "revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 3,
        },
        {
            "id": 3,
            "corruption_type": "Non-existent doc_id (DOC_99)",
            "claim_text": "Q2 FY26 revenue grew 2.2% QoQ and 2.9% YoY in CC terms.",
            "quote": "revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency",
            "doc_id": "DOC_99",
            "page": 2,
        },
        {
            "id": 4,
            "corruption_type": "Page outside read range (DOC_6 p. 190 of 195 — unread auditor/annexure page)",
            "claim_text": "Q2 FY26 revenue grew 2.2% QoQ and 2.9% YoY in CC terms.",
            "quote": "revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency",
            "doc_id": "DOC_6",
            "page": 190,
        },
        {
            "id": 5,
            "corruption_type": "Quote with one number changed ('2.4% sequentially' instead of '2.2% sequentially')",
            "claim_text": "Q2 FY26 revenue grew 2.4% QoQ and 2.9% YoY in CC terms.",
            "quote": "revenues for the quarter grew 2.4% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 2,
        },
        {
            "id": 6,
            "corruption_type": "Valid verbatim quote on p. 2, but claim text alters one number ('3.9% YoY' instead of '2.9% YoY')",
            "claim_text": "Q2 FY26 revenue grew 2.2% QoQ and 3.9% YoY in CC terms.",
            "quote": "revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 2,
        },
        {
            "id": 7,
            "corruption_type": "Valid verbatim quote on p. 2 ('21%'), but claim text adds unprinted decimal ('21.0%')",
            "claim_text": "Delivered Q2 FY26 operating margin of 21.0%.",
            "quote": "Our operating margin was 21%.",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 2,
        },
        {
            "id": 8,
            "corruption_type": "Quote from a different quarter's transcript (Q3 FY26 DOC_3 p. 4 cited against Q2 FY26 DOC_4 p. 2)",
            "claim_text": "Revised revenue growth guidance to 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.",
            "quote": "The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 2,
        },
        {
            "id": 9,
            "corruption_type": "Claim invents a bps figure (50 bps expansion) not present on the cited page",
            "claim_text": "Operating margin was 21%, expanding 50 bps QoQ.",
            "quote": "Our operating margin was 21%.",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 2,
        },
        {
            "id": 10,
            "corruption_type": "Claim invents a dollar deal-value count ($4.5 billion) not present on the cited page",
            "claim_text": "Growth between 2% and 3% backed by $4.5 billion in large deals.",
            "quote": "The new guidance is growth between 2% and 3% in constant currency terms for the full year.",
            "doc_id": "DOC_4",
            "page": 2,
        },
    ]

    results = []
    for tc in test_cases:
        passed, reasons = verify_single_claim(
            claim_text=tc["claim_text"],
            quote=tc["quote"],
            doc_id=tc["doc_id"],
            page=tc["page"],
            docs_by_id=docs_by_id,
            read_pages=read_pages,
        )
        results.append(
            {
                "id": tc["id"],
                "corruption_type": tc["corruption_type"],
                "doc_id": tc["doc_id"],
                "page": tc["page"],
                "claim_text": tc["claim_text"],
                "quote": tc["quote"],
                "rejected": not passed,
                "rejection_reasons": reasons,
            }
        )
    return results

"""
FINN Pipeline — Slice 5: On-Demand Company Research ("Narrative vs. Numbers").

Grounded STRICTLY in primary sources fetched from NSE (`nsearchives.nseindia.com`):
- Earnings conference call transcripts (`concall_transcript`)
- Quarterly financial results & board outcome filings (`results_filing`)

Hardened 4-Rule Citation Gate (enforced in Python via `citation_gate.py`):
1. `valid_doc_id`: `doc_id` must exist in the fetched NSE PDF manifest.
2. `exact_page_read`: `(doc_id, page)` must exist in `read_pages` (ZERO ±1 page tolerance).
3. `contiguous_quote_on_page`: `quote` must appear verbatim on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]`.
4. `exact_numbers_on_page`: Every quantitative number (%, $, ₹, bps, count) in BOTH
   `claim_text` (`guidance` or `actual`) AND `quote` must appear with exact digits
   on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]`.

For every verified claim, writes the cited page text and source URL to `evidence/{SYMBOL}/`.
"""

def infer_quarter_from_date(an_dt_str: str, text: str = "") -> str:
    """
    Infer Indian fiscal quarter label (e.g. 'Q2 FY27') from an NSE filing date.
    Indian FY runs April 1 to March 31:
    - Filing in Apr/May/Jun (period ended Mar 31, YYYY) -> Q4 FY{YY}
    - Filing in Jul/Aug/Sep (period ended Jun 30, YYYY) -> Q1 FY{YY+1}
    - Filing in Oct/Nov/Dec (period ended Sep 30, YYYY) -> Q2 FY{YY+1}
    - Filing in Jan/Feb/Mar (period ended Dec 31, YYYY-1) -> Q3 FY{YY}
    """
    dt = None
    for fmt in ("%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S", "%d-%b-%Y %H:%M", "%d-%b-%Y"):
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime(an_dt_str.strip(), fmt)
            break
        except ValueError:
            continue
    if not dt:
        return "Recent"

    m = dt.month
    y = dt.year
    if m in (4, 5, 6):
        return f"Q4 FY{str(y)[-2:]}"
    elif m in (7, 8, 9):
        return f"Q1 FY{str(y + 1)[-2:]}"
    elif m in (10, 11, 12):
        return f"Q2 FY{str(y + 1)[-2:]}"
    else:
        return f"Q3 FY{str(y)[-2:]}"


def discover_nse_primary_documents(
    session: creq.Session,
    ticker: str,
    days_back: int = 460,
) -> tuple[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """
    Query NSE Corporate Announcements over the last ~15 months (4-5 quarters)
    and select the official Earnings Call Transcripts and Financial Results
    filings for `ticker`.
    """
    sym = ticker_symbol(ticker)
    to_dt = datetime.now()
    from_dt = to_dt - timedelta(days=days_back)
    url = (
        f"https://www.nseindia.com/api/corporate-announcements"
        f"?index=equities&symbol={sym}"
        f"&from_date={from_dt.strftime('%d-%m-%Y')}"
        f"&to_date={to_dt.strftime('%d-%m-%Y')}"
    )
    resp = session.get(url, timeout=25)
    rows = resp.json() if resp.status_code == 200 else []
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        rows = []

    company_name = rows[0].get("sm_name", sym) if rows else sym

    transcripts_by_q: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    outcomes_by_q: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for r in rows:
        pdf_url = (r.get("attchmntFile") or "").strip()
        if not pdf_url.lower().endswith(".pdf"):
            continue
        desc = (r.get("desc") or "").strip()
        att_text = (r.get("attchmntText") or "").strip()
        comb = (desc + " " + att_text + " " + pdf_url.split("/")[-1]).lower()
        an_dt = (r.get("an_dt") or "").strip()
        q_label = infer_quarter_from_date(an_dt, comb)

        # 1. Earnings Call Transcripts (exclude AGM / AI Day / postal ballot)
        if "transcript" in comb and not any(
            skip in comb for skip in ["annual general meeting", "agm", "ai day", "postal ballot"]
        ):
            if q_label not in transcripts_by_q:
                transcripts_by_q[q_label] = {
                    "type": "concall_transcript",
                    "quarter": q_label,
                    "filing_date": an_dt.split(" ")[0],
                    "url": pdf_url,
                    "description": att_text[:160],
                }

        # 2. Quarterly Financial Results / Media Releases on Results
        elif (
            "outcome of board meeting" in comb
            or "financial results" in comb
            or ("media release" in comb and "results" in comb)
        ) and not any(
            skip in comb
            for skip in [
                "audio recording",
                "link of audio",
                "prior intimation",
                "will hold its earning",
                "newspaper",
                "udin",
                "trading window",
                "record date for",
            ]
        ):
            if q_label not in outcomes_by_q:
                outcomes_by_q[q_label] = {
                    "type": "results_filing",
                    "quarter": q_label,
                    "filing_date": an_dt.split(" ")[0],
                    "url": pdf_url,
                    "description": att_text[:160],
                }

    docs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for d in list(transcripts_by_q.values())[:5]:
        docs.append(d)
    for d in list(outcomes_by_q.values())[:5]:
        docs.append(d)

    return company_name, docs


def download_and_extract_pages(
    session: creq.Session,
    ticker: str,
    docs: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[tuple[str, int], str], str]:
    """
    Download each primary PDF into `data/documents/research/{SYM}/`, read pages
    via `pdfplumber`, and build:
    - `enriched_docs`: metadata list with `doc_id`, `pages`, `local_path`, `url`
    - `read_pages`: `{(doc_id, page_number): extracted_text}` for strict citation verification
    - `prompt_corpus`: formatted text corpus tagged with `[{doc_id} | PDF PAGE {p_num}]`
    """
    sym = ticker_symbol(ticker)
    ticker_dir = RESEARCH_DOCS_DIR / sym
    ticker_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    slice1_by_url: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    slice1_path = DATA_DIR / "slice1_extractions.json"
    if slice1_path.exists():
        try:
            for item in json.loads(slice1_path.read_text()):
                if item.get("status") == "ok" and item.get("source_url"):
                    slice1_by_url[item["source_url"]] = item
        except Exception:
            pass

    enriched_docs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    read_pages: dict[tuple[str, int], str] = {}
    corpus_blocks: list[str] = []

    for idx, d in enumerate(docs):
        doc_id = f"DOC_{idx + 1}"
        pdf_url = d["url"]
        fname = pdf_url.split("/")[-1]
        local_path = ticker_dir / fname

        if not local_path.exists():
            alt_results = DOCS_DIR / "results"
            found_alt = None
            for cand in alt_results.glob(f"{sym}_*.pdf"):
                if pdf_url in slice1_by_url and slice1_by_url[pdf_url].get("pdf_file") == cand.name:
                    found_alt = cand
                    break
            if found_alt and found_alt.exists():
                local_path.write_bytes(found_alt.read_bytes())
            else:
                try:
                    r = session.get(pdf_url, timeout=35)
                    if r.status_code == 200 and r.content[:4] == b"%PDF":
                        local_path.write_bytes(r.content)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"  ⚠️ Failed to download {pdf_url}: {e}")
                    continue

        if not local_path.exists():
            continue

        try:
            with pdfplumber.open(local_path) as pdf:
                total_pages = len(pdf.pages)
                doc_type = d["type"]
                q_label = d["quarter"]
                f_date = d["filing_date"]
                doc_title = (
                    f"{q_label} Concall Transcript ({f_date})"
                    if doc_type == "concall_transcript"
                    else f"{q_label} Results Filing ({f_date})"
                )

                pages_to_read: list[int] = []
                if doc_type == "concall_transcript":
                    pages_to_read = list(range(1, min(total_pages, 24) + 1))
                else:
                    pages_to_read = list(range(1, min(total_pages, 18) + 1))
                    if pdf_url in slice1_by_url:
                        sp = int(slice1_by_url[pdf_url]["source_page"])
                        if sp not in pages_to_read and 1 <= sp <= total_pages:
                            pages_to_read.append(sp)
                    for p_i in range(19, min(total_pages, 45) + 1):
                        if p_i not in pages_to_read:
                            pages_to_read.append(p_i)

                page_texts_for_doc: list[str] = []
                for p_num in sorted(pages_to_read):
                    raw_txt = (pdf.pages[p_num - 1].extract_text() or "").strip()
                    if pdf_url in slice1_by_url and slice1_by_url[pdf_url].get("source_page") == p_num:
                        s1 = slice1_by_url[pdf_url]
                        v_block = (
                            f"\n[Verified Statement Figures on Page {p_num} ({s1['basis']}, normalised to ₹ crore): "
                            f"{s1['summary']} | Raw in {s1['reported_unit']}: "
                            f"Revenue={s1['raw_in_reported_unit']['revenue']}, "
                            f"EBITDA={s1['raw_in_reported_unit']['ebitda_in_reported_unit']}, "
                            f"PBT={s1['raw_in_reported_unit']['pbt']}, "
                            f"PAT={s1['raw_in_reported_unit']['pat']}]"
                        )
                        raw_txt = (raw_txt + v_block).strip()

                    if len(raw_txt) < 40:
                        continue

                    read_pages[(doc_id, p_num)] = raw_txt
                    trimmed = raw_txt[:3200]
                    # Redact internal transcript footers like "Page 2 of 37" in the prompt
                    # so the model never confuses the footer number with PDF PAGE p_num.
                    prompt_safe_txt = re.sub(
                        r"\bPage\s+\d+\s+of\s+\d+\b",
                        f"[PDF_PAGE_{p_num}]",
                        trimmed,
                        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                    )
                    page_texts_for_doc.append(
                        f"[{doc_id} | PDF PAGE {p_num} | {doc_title}]\n"
                        f"{prompt_safe_txt}\n"
                        f"[END OF {doc_id} | PDF PAGE {p_num}]"
                    )

                if not page_texts_for_doc:
                    continue

                enriched_docs.append(
                    {
                        "doc_id": doc_id,
                        "title": doc_title,
                        "type": doc_type,
                        "quarter": q_label,
                        "filing_date": f_date,
                        "url": pdf_url,
                        "pages": total_pages,
                        "pages_read": len(page_texts_for_doc),
                    }
                )
                corpus_blocks.append(
                    f"================================================================\n"
                    f"DOCUMENT {doc_id}: {doc_title} (File: {fname}, Total Pages: {total_pages})\n"
                    f"================================================================\n"
                    + "\n\n".join(page_texts_for_doc)
                )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ⚠️ Error reading {local_path.name}: {e}")
            continue

    return enriched_docs, read_pages, "\n\n".join(corpus_blocks)

def verify_and_write_evidence(
    ticker: str,
    raw_nvn: dict[str, Any],
    docs_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    read_pages: dict[tuple[str, int], str],
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Run `verify_single_claim()` (zero ±1 page tolerance + exact number matching)
    on every claim, reject any claim that fails, and write verified evidence
    files (`evidence/{SYM}/claims.json` + `evidence/{SYM}/{doc_id}_p{page}.txt`).
    """
    sym = ticker_symbol(ticker)
    sym_ev_dir = EVIDENCE_DIR / sym
    sym_ev_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Clear old evidence files for this symbol before writing fresh verified ones
    for old_f in sym_ev_dir.glob("*"):
        if old_f.is_file():
            old_f.unlink()

    stats: dict[str, Any] = {
        "verified_claims": 0,
        "rejected_claims": 0,
        "rejections_detail": [],
    }
    evidence_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    verified_quarters: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    claim_counter = 0

    for q in raw_nvn.get("quarters") or []:
        if not isinstance(q, dict):
            continue
        q_name = str(q.get("quarter") or "Quarter")
        raw_guided = q.get("guided") or []
        raw_delivered = q.get("delivered") or []

        clean_guided: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        clean_delivered: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        max_len = max(len(raw_guided), len(raw_delivered))
        for i in range(max_len):
            g = raw_guided[i] if i < len(raw_guided) and isinstance(raw_guided[i], dict) else None
            d = raw_delivered[i] if i < len(raw_delivered) and isinstance(raw_delivered[i], dict) else None
            if not g or not d:
                stats["rejected_claims"] += 1
                continue

            g_txt = str(g.get("guidance") or "").strip()
            g_quote = str(g.get("quote") or "").strip()
            g_doc = str(g.get("doc_id") or "").strip()
            g_page_raw = g.get("page")

            d_txt = str(d.get("actual") or "").strip()
            d_quote = str(d.get("quote") or "").strip()
            d_doc = str(d.get("doc_id") or "").strip()
            d_page_raw = d.get("page")

            g_ok, g_reasons = verify_single_claim(
                g_txt, g_quote, g_doc, g_page_raw, docs_by_id, read_pages
            )
            d_ok, d_reasons = verify_single_claim(
                d_txt, d_quote, d_doc, d_page_raw, docs_by_id, read_pages
            )

            if not g_ok:
                stats["rejected_claims"] += 1
                stats["rejections_detail"].append(
                    {
                        "quarter": q_name,
                        "type": "guided",
                        "doc_id": g_doc,
                        "page": g_page_raw,
                        "claim": g_txt,
                        "quote": g_quote,
                        "reasons": g_reasons,
                    }
                )
                print(f"    ❌ REJECTED [{q_name} guided] ({g_doc} p.{g_page_raw}): {g_reasons}")
            if not d_ok:
                stats["rejected_claims"] += 1
                stats["rejections_detail"].append(
                    {
                        "quarter": q_name,
                        "type": "delivered",
                        "doc_id": d_doc,
                        "page": d_page_raw,
                        "claim": d_txt,
                        "quote": d_quote,
                        "reasons": d_reasons,
                    }
                )
                print(f"    ❌ REJECTED [{q_name} delivered] ({d_doc} p.{d_page_raw}): {d_reasons}")

            if not (g_ok and d_ok):
                continue

            g_page = int(g_page_raw)
            d_page = int(d_page_raw)
            g_meta = docs_by_id[g_doc]
            d_meta = docs_by_id[d_doc]

            # Write cited page texts to evidence/{SYM}/{doc_id}_p{page}.txt
            for doc_key, pg_num, meta in [(g_doc, g_page, g_meta), (d_doc, d_page, d_meta)]:
                ev_txt_path = sym_ev_dir / f"{doc_key}_p{pg_num}.txt"
                if not ev_txt_path.exists():
                    header = (
                        f"TICKER: {ticker}\n"
                        f"DOCUMENT_ID: {doc_key}\n"
                        f"DOCUMENT_TITLE: {meta['title']}\n"
                        f"PDF_PAGE: {pg_num} (of {meta['pages']})\n"
                        f"SOURCE_URL: {meta['url']}#page={pg_num}\n"
                        f"{'=' * 72}\n\n"
                    )
                    ev_txt_path.write_text(header + read_pages[(doc_key, pg_num)])

            g_url = f"{g_meta['url']}#page={g_page}"
            d_url = f"{d_meta['url']}#page={d_page}"
            g_ev_rel = f"evidence/{sym}/{g_doc}_p{g_page}.txt"
            d_ev_rel = f"evidence/{sym}/{d_doc}_p{d_page}.txt"

            g_source = f"{g_meta['title']}, PDF p. {g_page} — \"{g_quote[:110]}\""
            d_source = f"{d_meta['title']}, PDF p. {d_page} — \"{d_quote[:110]}\""

            clean_guided.append(
                {
                    "metric": g.get("metric", "Metric"),
                    "guidance": g_txt,
                    "source": g_source,
                    "source_url": g_url,
                    "doc_id": g_doc,
                    "page": g_page,
                    "evidence_file": g_ev_rel,
                }
            )
            clean_delivered.append(
                {
                    "metric": d.get("metric", g.get("metric", "Metric")),
                    "actual": d_txt,
                    "source": d_source,
                    "source_url": d_url,
                    "doc_id": d_doc,
                    "page": d_page,
                    "evidence_file": d_ev_rel,
                }
            )
            stats["verified_claims"] += 2

            for kind_label, c_txt, c_quote, doc_k, pg_n, meta_obj, s_url, ev_rel in [
                ("guided", g_txt, g_quote, g_doc, g_page, g_meta, g_url, g_ev_rel),
                ("delivered", d_txt, d_quote, d_doc, d_page, d_meta, d_url, d_ev_rel),
            ]:
                claim_counter += 1
                evidence_records.append(
                    {
                        "claim_id": f"{sym}-{claim_counter:02d}",
                        "ticker": ticker,
                        "quarter": q_name,
                        "type": kind_label,
                        "metric": g.get("metric", "Metric"),
                        "claim_text": c_txt,
                        "verbatim_quote": c_quote,
                        "numbers_verified_on_page": extract_quantitative_numbers(c_txt),
                        "doc_id": doc_k,
                        "doc_title": meta_obj["title"],
                        "pdf_page": pg_n,
                        "source_url": s_url,
                        "evidence_page_file": ev_rel,
                    }
                )

        if clean_guided and clean_delivered:
            verdict = str(q.get("verdict") or "hit").lower()
            if verdict not in ("beat", "hit", "miss"):
                verdict = "hit"
            verified_quarters.append(
                {
                    "quarter": q_name,
                    "guided": clean_guided,
                    "delivered": clean_delivered,
                    "verdict": verdict,
                    "commentary": q.get("commentary", ""),
                }
            )

    save_json(sym_ev_dir / "claims.json", evidence_records)

    cred = str(raw_nvn.get("credibility_score") or "medium").lower()
    if cred not in ("high", "medium", "low"):
        cred = "medium"

    return (
        {
            "summary": raw_nvn.get("summary", ""),
            "quarters": verified_quarters,
            "credibility_score": cred,
            "pattern": raw_nvn.get("pattern", ""),
        },
        stats,
    )


def generate_research_for_ticker(
    session: creq.Session,
    ticker: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sym = ticker_symbol(ticker)
    print(f"\n🔎 Discovering NSE primary documents for {ticker}...")

"""
Step 4: Completeness check for HDFCBANK.NS over 30 days against live NSE API.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from config import ANN_DIR, DATA_DIR, save_json
from fetch_announcements import (
    create_nse_session,
    fetch_nse_announcements_for_ticker,
    select_representative_nse_rows,
)


def main() -> None:
    session = create_nse_session()
    days_back = 30
    to_dt = datetime.now()
    from_dt = to_dt - timedelta(days=days_back)

    raw_rows = fetch_nse_announcements_for_ticker(session, "HDFCBANK.NS", days_back=days_back)

    # Break down the raw NSE API response
    xml_rows = [r for r in raw_rows if (r.get("attchmntFile") or "").lower().endswith(".xml")]
    non_xml_rows = [r for r in raw_rows if not (r.get("attchmntFile") or "").lower().endswith(".xml")]

    seen_keys = set()
    deduped_non_xml = []
    for r in non_xml_rows:
        pdf_url = (r.get("attchmntFile") or "").strip()
        desc = (r.get("desc") or "").strip()
        txt = (r.get("attchmntText") or "").strip()
        dt = (r.get("an_dt") or "").strip()
        key = pdf_url if pdf_url else f"{desc}|{txt}|{dt}"
        if key not in seen_keys:
            seen_keys.add(key)
            deduped_non_xml.append(r)

    capped_rows = select_representative_nse_rows(raw_rows, max_items=6)

    saved_file = ANN_DIR / "HDFCBANK.json"
    saved_rows = json.loads(saved_file.read_text()) if saved_file.exists() else []

    by_desc: dict[str, int] = {}
    for r in raw_rows:
        d = (r.get("desc") or "Unknown").strip()
        by_desc[d] = by_desc.get(d, 0) + 1

    report = {
        "ticker": "HDFCBANK.NS",
        "window_days": days_back,
        "from_date": from_dt.strftime("%d-%m-%Y"),
        "to_date": to_dt.strftime("%d-%m-%Y"),
        "nse_endpoint": (
            f"https://www.nseindia.com/api/corporate-announcements"
            f"?index=equities&symbol=HDFCBANK"
            f"&from_date={from_dt.strftime('%d-%m-%Y')}&to_date={to_dt.strftime('%d-%m-%Y')}"
        ),
        "is_nse_api_paginated": False,
        "nse_pagination_explanation": (
            "NSE's /api/corporate-announcements endpoint is NOT paginated when queried with "
            "symbol + from_date + to_date; it returns the complete JSON array of all corporate "
            "announcements filed in that window in a single HTTP response."
        ),
        "is_our_pipeline_capped": True,
        "our_pipeline_cap_explanation": (
            "Our pipeline (fetch_announcements.py -> select_representative_nse_rows) intentionally "
            "filters out duplicate XBRL .xml attachments, deduplicates by PDF URL, and caps LLM "
            "classification at max_items=6 per ticker (keeping the 2 newest filings + highest-priority "
            "material filings like Outcome of Board Meeting, Appointment/Cessation, Press Release, "
            "Dividend/Ratings while dropping repetitive 'Loss of Share Certificates' and daily ESOP "
            "allotment noise)."
        ),
        "counts": {
            "nse_raw_total_30d": len(raw_rows),
            "nse_xml_xbrl_duplicates": len(xml_rows),
            "nse_non_xml_filings": len(non_xml_rows),
            "nse_unique_pdf_filings": len(deduped_non_xml),
            "pipeline_capped_for_llm_triage": len(capped_rows),
            "saved_in_data_announcements_hdfcbank_json": len(saved_rows),
        },
        "nse_raw_breakdown_by_subject": by_desc,
        "all_nse_raw_filings_30d": [
            {
                "an_dt": r.get("an_dt"),
                "desc": r.get("desc"),
                "attchmntText": (r.get("attchmntText") or "")[:160],
                "attchmntFile": r.get("attchmntFile"),
            }
            for r in raw_rows
        ],
    }

    save_json(DATA_DIR / "hdfcbank_completeness_30d.json", report)
    print(json.dumps(report["counts"], indent=2))
    print("\nBreakdown by NSE subject (desc):")
    for k, v in sorted(by_desc.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
        print(f"  {v:2d}x | {k}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

### 2. Tightening the Gate (`±1` Page Tolerance Removed + Exact Number Match)

We tightened [`verify_single_claim()`](file:///Users/anmolgupta/Desktop/Enam%20Holdings/finn/pipeline/citation_gate.py#L78-L145) as follows:
1. **`±1` page tolerance completely removed**: `(doc_id, int(page))` must be the exact 1-indexed PDF page where the quote and numbers reside.
2. **Contiguous substring match**: `quote` (normalised for whitespace) must appear as a contiguous substring on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]` (replaced the old 65% word-overlap heuristic).
3. **100% exact number match**: Every quantitative number (`\d+(?:,\d+)*(?:\.\d+)?`) in both `claim_text` and `quote` must appear with **exact digits** on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]`.

def select_representative_nse_rows(
    raw_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    max_items: int = 6,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Deduplicate NSE rows by attachment URL / text and select up to `max_items`
    per ticker, prioritising non-routine filings + the most recent filings so
    24h/14d/30d windows show both high-signal items and collapsed routine noise.
    """
    seen_keys: set[str] = set()
    deduped: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for r in raw_rows:
        pdf_url = (r.get("attchmntFile") or "").strip()
        if pdf_url.lower().endswith(".xml"):
            # Skip duplicate XBRL XML rows when NSE already provides the PDF row
            continue
        desc = (r.get("desc") or "").strip()
        txt = (r.get("attchmntText") or "").strip()
        dt = (r.get("an_dt") or "").strip()
        key = pdf_url if pdf_url else f"{desc}|{txt}|{dt}"
        if key in seen_keys:
            continue
        seen_keys.add(key)
        deduped.append(r)

    # Score rows so material subjects (Outcome of Board Meeting, Appointment,
    # Cessation, Acquisition, Press Release, Dividend, Order) are never crowded
    # out by 20 "Loss of Share Certificates" notices.
    def _row_priority_hint(r: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        d = ((r.get("desc") or "") + " " + (r.get("attchmntText") or "")).lower()
        if any(
            k in d
            for k in [
                "outcome of board meeting",
                "financial results",
                "appointment",
                "cessation",
                "resignation",
                "acquisition",
                "amalgamation",
                "merger",
                "dividend",
                "buyback",
                "press release",
                "media release",
                "credit rating",
            ]
        ):
            return 0
        if "loss of share" in d or "duplicate share" in d or "newspaper" in d:
            return 2
        return 1

    # Always keep the 2 most recent filings (for 24h freshness) + top priority filings
    recent_two = deduped[:2]
    rest = sorted(deduped[2:], key=_row_priority_hint)
    combined = recent_two + rest
    return combined[:max_items]


def process_ticker_announcements(
    session: creq.Session,
    ticker: str,
    days_back: int = 30,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    sym = ticker_symbol(ticker)
    ann_path = ANN_DIR / f"{sym}.json"

    # Load existing announcements so we preserve verified Slice 1 results extractions
    existing_by_url: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    existing_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if ann_path.exists():
        try:
            for a in json.loads(ann_path.read_text()):
                if a.get("category") == "results" and a.get("enrichment"):
                    if a.get("source_url"):
                        existing_by_url[a["source_url"]] = a
                    existing_results.append(a)
        except Exception:
            pass

    raw_rows = fetch_nse_announcements_for_ticker(session, ticker, days_back=days_back)
    selected_rows = select_representative_nse_rows(raw_rows, max_items=6)

    to_classify: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    preserved: list[dict[str, Any]] = list(existing_results)
    preserved_urls = {a.get("source_url") for a in preserved if a.get("source_url")}

    for r in selected_rows:
        pdf_url = (r.get("attchmntFile") or "").strip()
        if pdf_url and pdf_url in preserved_urls:
            continue
        to_classify.append(r)

    if not to_classify:
        save_json(ann_path, preserved)
        return preserved

    company_name = (
        to_classify[0].get("sm_name")
        or (preserved[0].get("company_name") if preserved else sym)
    )

    items_payload = [
        {
            "index": idx,
            "date": r.get("an_dt", ""),
            "subject": r.get("desc", ""),
            "details": (r.get("attchmntText") or "")[:500],
        }
        for idx, r in enumerate(to_classify)
    ]

    prompt = CLASSIFICATION_PROMPT.format(
        ticker=ticker,
        company=company_name,
        items_json=json.dumps(items_payload, indent=2),
    )
    llm_out, model_used, t_in, t_out = call_gemini_multimodal(
        prompt=prompt,
        image_png_bytes=None,
        task="classify_nse_v1",
        ticker=ticker,
    )
    classifications = {
        int(c["index"]): c
        for c in (llm_out.get("classifications") or [])
        if isinstance(c, dict) and "index" in c
    }

    per_item_in = max(1, t_in // len(to_classify))
    per_item_out = max(1, t_out // len(to_classify))

    final_anns: list[dict[str, Any]] = list(preserved)
    for idx, r in enumerate(to_classify):
        c = classifications.get(idx, {})
        cat = c.get("category", "unclassified")
        if cat not in ANNOUNCEMENT_CATEGORIES:
            cat = "unclassified"
        prio = int(c.get("priority") or CATEGORY_PRIORITY.get(cat, 3))
        if prio not in (1, 2, 3):
            prio = 3

        pdf_url = (r.get("attchmntFile") or "").strip()
        raw_dt = (r.get("an_dt") or "").strip()
        iso_ts = parse_nse_timestamp(raw_dt)
        desc = (r.get("desc") or "Filing").strip()
        att_text = (r.get("attchmntText") or "").strip()
        headline = f"{desc} — {att_text}" if att_text and att_text != desc else desc
        summary = c.get("summary") or att_text or desc

        uid_seed = f"{ticker}|{raw_dt}|{pdf_url or headline}"
        ann_id = f"nse-{sym.lower()}-{hashlib.sha256(uid_seed.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]}"

        enrichment: dict[str, Any] = {}
        item_model = model_used
        item_tokens = {"in": per_item_in, "out": per_item_out}

        if cat == "results" and not enrichment and preserved:
            cat = "unclassified"
            prio = 3

        # Enrich management_change filings from the actual PDF attachment
        if cat == "management_change":
            try:
                enrichment, mgmt_summary, m_model, m_tok = enrich_management_change(
                    session=session,
                    ticker=ticker,
                    company=company_name,
                    headline=headline,
                    pdf_url=pdf_url,
                    fallback_text=att_text or desc,
                )
                if mgmt_summary:
                    summary = mgmt_summary
                item_model = m_model
                item_tokens = {
                    "in": per_item_in + m_tok["in"],
                    "out": per_item_out + m_tok["out"],
                }
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  ⚠️ Management enrichment failed for {ticker}: {e}")

        final_anns.append(
            {
                "id": ann_id,
                "ticker": ticker,
                "company_name": company_name,
                "timestamp": iso_ts,
                "headline": headline[:280],
                "category": cat,
                "priority": prio,
                "summary": summary,
                "source_url": pdf_url,
                "raw_text": att_text or desc,
                "enrichment": enrichment,
                "model_used": item_model,
                "tokens": item_tokens,
            }
        )

    # Sort by timestamp descending
    final_anns.sort(key=lambda a: a.get("timestamp", ""), reverse=True)
    save_json(ann_path, final_anns)
    return final_anns


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=" * 64)
    print("FINN — Fetching, classifying & enriching NSE announcements")
    print("=" * 64)
    sess = create_nse_session()
    total_count = 0
    for t in PORTFOLIO_TICKERS:
        print(f"\n📋 {t}...")
        anns = process_ticker_announcements(sess, t, days_back=30)
        total_count += len(anns)
        p1 = sum(1 for a in anns if a["priority"] == 1)
        p2 = sum(1 for a in anns if a["priority"] == 2)
        p3 = sum(1 for a in anns if a["priority"] == 3)
        print(f"  ✅ {len(anns)} total ({p1} material, {p2} notable, {p3} routine)")
        time.sleep(0.4)
    print(f"\nDone. {total_count} announcements across {len(PORTFOLIO_TICKERS)} portfolio stocks.")

"""
FINN Pipeline — Hardened Citation Gate (v3) & 12-Case Negative Test Suite.

Enforces strict primary-source verification on every "Narrative vs. Numbers"
claim (`guided` and `delivered`):
1. `valid_doc_id`: `doc_id` must exist in the fetched NSE PDF manifest.
2. `exact_page_read`: `(doc_id, page)` must exist in `read_pages` (NO ±1 page
   tolerance — the exact integer page number cited must have been extracted).
3. `contiguous_quote_on_page`: The cited `quote` (after normalising whitespace)
   must appear verbatim on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]`.
4. `exact_numbers_on_page`: Every quantitative number in BOTH `claim_text`
   AND `quote` must appear on `read_pages[(doc_id, page)]` with exact digits.
5. `claim_numbers_in_quote` (Rule 2a): Every quantitative number in `claim_text`
   must appear inside the cited `quote` itself, not merely elsewhere on the same page.
6. `chronology_rule` (Rule 2b): For any `guided` claim, the cited document's
   fiscal period `(fy, quarter)` must be STRICTLY EARLIER (`<`) than the
   `delivered` document's fiscal period (rejects hindsight / same-quarter or
   later-quarter citations as "prior guidance").
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


# Standard non-quantitative tokens in Indian financial filings (quarter/FY labels,
# network generation 5G, business model 1P/3P, segment O2C, field KG-D6).
LABEL_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:Q[1-4]|FY\s*'?\d{2,4}|[12]H|H[12]|5G|4G|1P|3P|O2C|KG-D6|B2B|B2C)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

# Number pattern capturing integers and decimals (with optional thousand commas)
NUMBER_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])(\d+(?:,\d+)*(?:\.\d+)?)(?![A-Za-z])")

QUARTER_PARSE_RE = re.compile(r"Q([1-4])\s*FY\s*'?(\d{2,4})", re.IGNORECASE)


def parse_quarter_rank(text: str | None) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    """
    Parse a fiscal period string like 'Q1 FY27' or 'Q3 FY2026' into `(fy_2digit, q_int)`,
    e.g. `(27, 1)` or `(26, 3)`, so periods can be compared chronologically with `<`.
    """
    if not text:
        return None
    m = QUARTER_PARSE_RE.search(text)
    if not m:
        return None
    q_int = int(m.group(1))
    fy_raw = int(m.group(2))
    fy_2d = fy_raw % 100
    return (fy_2d, q_int)


def extract_quantitative_numbers(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """
    Extract all quantitative number strings from `text` after masking out
    quarter/fiscal-year labels (Q1..Q4, FY26, 1H, 5G, 1P, O2C, KG-D6).
    Normalises thousand-separator commas ('72,275' -> '72275') while preserving
    exact decimal digits ('21.0' stays '21.0', NOT '21').
    """
    if not text:
        return []
    masked = LABEL_TOKEN_RE.sub(" ", text)
    raw_nums = NUMBER_TOKEN_RE.findall(masked)
    return [n.replace(",", "") for n in raw_nums]


def _normalise_for_substring(s: str) -> str:
    """Lowercase and collapse runs of whitespace/punctuation to single spaces."""
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9%.]+", " ", s.lower()).strip()


def verify_single_claim(
    claim_text: str,
    quote: str,
    doc_id: str,
    page: Any,
    docs_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    read_pages: dict[tuple[str, int], str],
    claim_kind: str | None = None,
    evaluated_quarter: str | None = None,
    delivered_doc_quarters: list[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
    """
    Verify a single claim against `docs_by_id` and `read_pages` with:
    - ZERO ±1 page tolerance
    - Exact verbatim quote on page
    - Every number in `claim_text` present inside `quote` itself (Rule 2a)
    - Strict chronology `guided_period < delivered_period` for `guided` claims (Rule 2b)
    Returns `(passed, rejection_reasons)`.
    """
    reasons: list[str] = []

    # 1. Check doc_id exists in fetched manifest
    doc_id_clean = str(doc_id or "").strip()
    if not doc_id_clean or doc_id_clean not in docs_by_id:
        reasons.append(f"invalid_doc_id ({doc_id_clean!r} not in fetched manifest)")
        return False, reasons

    doc_meta = docs_by_id[doc_id_clean]

    # 2. Check exact page was read (NO ±1 page tolerance)
    try:
        page_int = int(page)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        reasons.append(f"non_integer_page ({page!r})")
        return False, reasons

    if (doc_id_clean, page_int) not in read_pages:
        reasons.append(
            f"page_not_read (({doc_id_clean}, p.{page_int}) not in read_pages; ±1 tolerance disabled)"
        )
        return False, reasons

    page_text = read_pages[(doc_id_clean, page_int)]
    norm_page = _normalise_for_substring(page_text)
    page_numbers = set(extract_quantitative_numbers(page_text))

    # 3. Verbatim quote check on the exact page
    quote_clean = (quote or "").strip()
    if len(quote_clean) < 8:
        reasons.append("quote_too_short_or_missing")
        return False, reasons

    segments = [
        _normalise_for_substring(seg)
        for seg in re.split(r"\.{2,}|…", quote_clean)
        if len(_normalise_for_substring(seg)) >= 4
    ]
    if not segments:
        reasons.append("quote_empty_after_normalisation")
        return False, reasons

    for seg in segments:
        if seg not in norm_page:
            reasons.append(
                f"quote_not_on_page (segment {seg[:60]!r} not found on {doc_id_clean} p.{page_int})"
            )
            break

    # 4. Every quantitative number in `quote` must appear on the page
    quote_nums = extract_quantitative_numbers(quote_clean)
    quote_nums_set = set(quote_nums)
    missing_quote_nums = [n for n in quote_nums if n not in page_numbers]
    if missing_quote_nums:
        reasons.append(
            f"quote_numbers_missing_on_page ({missing_quote_nums} not on {doc_id_clean} p.{page_int})"
        )

    # 5. Every quantitative number in `claim_text` must appear on the page AND inside `quote` itself (Rule 2a)
    claim_nums = extract_quantitative_numbers(claim_text or "")
    missing_claim_nums_page = [n for n in claim_nums if n not in page_numbers]
    if missing_claim_nums_page:
        reasons.append(
            f"claim_numbers_missing_on_page ({missing_claim_nums_page} in claim {claim_text!r} not on {doc_id_clean} p.{page_int})"
        )

    missing_claim_nums_quote = [n for n in claim_nums if n not in quote_nums_set]
    if missing_claim_nums_quote:
        reasons.append(
            f"claim_numbers_missing_in_quote ({missing_claim_nums_quote} in claim {claim_text!r} not inside cited quote)"
        )

    # 6. Chronology Rule (Rule 2b): For `guided` claims, the guided doc's period must be
    # STRICTLY EARLIER than the delivered doc's period / evaluated quarter.
    if claim_kind == "guided":
        guided_q_str = doc_meta.get("quarter") or doc_meta.get("title") or ""
        g_rank = parse_quarter_rank(guided_q_str)

        target_ranks: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
        if evaluated_quarter:
            er = parse_quarter_rank(evaluated_quarter)
            if er:
                target_ranks.append(er)
        if delivered_doc_quarters:
            for dq in delivered_doc_quarters:
                dr = parse_quarter_rank(dq)
                if dr:
                    target_ranks.append(dr)

        if g_rank is not None and target_ranks:
            min_target = min(target_ranks)
            if not (g_rank < min_target):
                reasons.append(
                    f"chronology_violation (guided doc {doc_id_clean} [{guided_q_str}] period Q{g_rank[1]} FY{g_rank[0]} "
                    f"is not strictly earlier than delivered period Q{min_target[1]} FY{min_target[0]})"
                )

    return len(reasons) == 0, reasons

args.Content:
"""
Item 3: Page Selection Audit & Guidance Recall Check on PIDILITIND.NS.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from config import DATA_DIR, RESEARCH_DIR, save_json
from fetch_announcements import create_nse_session
from generate_research import discover_nse_primary_documents, download_and_extract_pages


def main() -> None:
    sess = create_nse_session()
    _, docs = discover_nse_primary_documents(sess, "PIDILITIND.NS", days_back=460)
    enriched, read_pages, corpus = download_and_extract_pages(sess, "PIDILITIND.NS", docs)

    raw_total_chars = sum(len(t) for t in read_pages.values())
    corpus_total_chars = len(corpus)
    sent_corpus = corpus[:180000]

    # Check which (doc_id, page) markers appear inside sent_corpus vs dropped after 180,000 chars
    included_markers = re.findall(r"\[(DOC_\d+)\s*\|\s*PDF PAGE\s*(\d+)", sent_corpus)
    all_markers = re.findall(r"\[(DOC_\d+)\s*\|\s*PDF PAGE\s*(\d+)", corpus)
    included_set = {(d, int(p)) for d, p in included_markers}
    all_set = {(d, int(p)) for d, p in all_markers}
    dropped_set = sorted(all_set - included_set, key=lambda x: (int(x[0].split("_")[1]), x[1]))

    # Check how many pages had > 3200 chars truncated per page
    truncated_pages = [
        {"doc_id": d, "page": p, "raw_chars": len(txt), "chars_dropped_on_page": len(txt) - 3200}
        for (d, p), txt in sorted(read_pages.items(), key=lambda x: (int(x[0][0].split("_")[1]), x[0][1]))
        if len(txt) > 3200
    ]

    # Scan all 103 transcript pages (DOC_1..DOC_5) for sentences containing guidance/target/corridor/range/outlook
    guidance_kw = re.compile(
        r"\b(guid\w*|corridor|target\w*|aspir\w*|range of|band of|double digit\w*|capex|a&sp|spends|vam\b)",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    guidance_mentions = []
    for (doc_id, p_num), txt in sorted(read_pages.items(), key=lambda x: (int(x[0][0].split("_")[1]), x[0][1])):
        if int(doc_id.split("_")[1]) > 5:
            continue
        for line in re.split(r"(?<=[.?!])\s+", txt):
            clean_line = " ".join(line.split())
            if guidance_kw.search(clean_line) and re.search(r"\d", clean_line) and 40 <= len(clean_line) <= 320:
                in_3200 = txt.find(line[:30]) < 3200 if line[:30] in txt else True
                guidance_mentions.append(
                    {
                        "doc_id": doc_id,
                        "page": p_num,
                        "in_3200_window": in_3200,
                        "sentence": clean_line,
                    }
                )

    report = {
        "ticker": "PIDILITIND.NS",
        "total_pdfs_discovered": len(enriched),
        "total_pages_in_pdfs": sum(d["pages"] for d in enriched),
        "pages_extracted_non_empty": len(read_pages),
        "stage_1_raw_extracted_chars": raw_total_chars,
        "stage_2_after_3200_char_per_page_cap": corpus_total_chars,
        "stage_3_after_180000_char_prompt_slice": len(sent_corpus),
        "pages_included_in_180k_prompt": len(included_set),
        "pages_dropped_by_180k_slice": len(dropped_set),
        "pages_truncated_by_3200_char_cap": len(truncated_pages),
        "dropped_docs_summary": (
            f"All 5 concall transcripts (DOC_1..DOC_5, 103 pages) were included in the 180k prompt slice, "
            f"plus DOC_6 p.1-2. The remaining {len(dropped_set)} pages (DOC_6 p.3-14 and all of DOC_7..DOC_10, "
            f"which are the 5 financial results filings) were cut off by corpus[:180000]."
        ),
        "truncated_pages_detail": truncated_pages[:15],
        "guidance_sentences_found_in_transcripts": guidance_mentions,
    }
    save_json(DATA_DIR / "pidilite_recall_audit.json", report)
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k not in ("truncated_pages_detail", "guidance_sentences_found_in_transcripts")}, indent=2))
    print(f"\nFound {len(guidance_mentions)} quantitative guidance/target sentences across DOC_1..DOC_5:")
    for gm in guidance_mentions[:25]:
        print(f"  [{gm['doc_id']} p.{gm['page']} | in_3200={gm['in_3200_window']}] {gm['sentence']}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Set up Vercel for your AI coding agent

Use this playbook to prepare the current agent for Vercel. Install the CLI, guidance, and MCP connection once; link individual projects only when project operations require it.

## How to run

Run section 1 once per machine. Run sections 2 and 3 once per coding agent. In section 2, try the Vercel plugin first and use standalone skills only if the plugin can't be used.

For section 3, follow the route for your client below or in the [Vercel MCP docs](https://vercel.com/docs/agent-resources/vercel-mcp). If neither covers it, adapt the closest route. If a step is blocked, record why and continue with the remaining steps.

Perform actions yourself when terminal or file access is available. Global or user-scoped installation is the default. Pause only for user authentication, approval, or UI actions you cannot perform. Do not merely return commands for the user to copy.

## 1. Install the Vercel CLI

Check for an existing installation:

```sh
vercel --version
```

If the CLI is missing, install the latest version:

```sh
npm install --global vercel@latest
vercel --version
```

If the installed CLI reports that an update is available, run the same global install command. Use bare `vercel` commands for all subsequent operations.

If `whoami` reports that no user is authenticated, you can use `vercel signup` to create an account on the behalf of the user, or `vercel login` if they already have one.

Pause while the user completes sign-up or sign-in, then verify using:

```sh
vercel whoami
```

Do not create or link a Vercel project during global setup. Link a project later when a deployment or project-specific operation requires it.

## 2. Add Vercel guidance

Install either the Vercel plugin or standalone skills—not both.

### Preferred: Vercel plugin

The plugin requires Node.js 18+. Install it if missing and you can, then run:

```sh
node --version
npx plugins add vercel/vercel-plugin
```

Use standalone skills if you know your agent doesn't support plugins, the install reports it unsupported, or Node.js can't be installed. For other errors, check the [plugin docs](https://vercel.com/docs/agent-resources/vercel-plugin) once before falling back.

In OpenCode, use OpenCode's own command instead. It doesn't need Node.js:

```sh
opencode plugin add github:vercel/vercel-plugin
```

Install the plugin once for the current agent. Confirm it is enabled across projects and that a command such as `/vercel-plugin:status` is discoverable. In OpenCode, the command is `/vercel:status`.

Reload only if the newly installed commands are missing.

### Fallback: standalone skills

Use this for any of the reasons above:

```sh
npx skills list
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --global
npx skills list
```

Choose the current agent if prompted and confirm the installation path. The standalone pack is smaller than the plugin and does not include its complete command, agent, and automation system.

## 3. Connect Vercel MCP

Connect the shared Vercel MCP endpoint once to access Vercel projects, deployments, logs, and analytics across projects.

If you know your client supports remote MCP with OAuth, use its route below. If it supports only stdio servers, configure the client's MCP server command as `npx` with arguments `["mcp-remote", "https://mcp.vercel.com"]`, as in the Gemini CLI route. If unsure, try the route; record MCP as blocked only if it fails.

Before changing a MCP configuration file, inspect it and merge the `vercel` entry without replacing unrelated settings.

For clients supported by the Vercel CLI, configure the shared endpoint:

```sh
vercel mcp --clients "<client>"
```

Use the exact `<client>` value:

- Claude Code: `Claude Code`
- Cursor: `Cursor`
- VS Code with GitHub Copilot: `VS Code with Copilot`

Other supported values are in the [CLI MCP docs](https://vercel.com/docs/cli/mcp). If your client isn't supported, use its route below instead. Use only one route per client.

This is the default. Use `--project` only when the user explicitly requests a project-scoped MCP connection.

### Claude Code

Manual user-scoped fallback:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http vercel --scope user https://mcp.vercel.com
```

Inspect existing MCP entries before adding. To authenticate, open `/mcp`, select `vercel`, and choose the authentication action.

### Codex CLI

First inspect:

```bash
codex mcp list
```

Codex is not a supported `vercel mcp --clients` target. Its documented add command uses Codex's user-wide configuration:

```bash
codex mcp add vercel --url https://mcp.vercel.com
```

Codex should open a browser during setup. If the server exists but is not authenticated, run:

```bash
codex mcp login vercel
```

### Cursor

Manual fallback: merge this into `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vercel": {
      "url": "https://mcp.vercel.com"
    }
  }
}
```

Cursor displays `Needs login` when authorization is required. Ask the user to click it.

### VS Code with GitHub Copilot

Run **MCP: Add Server**, choose **HTTP**, enter `https://mcp.vercel.com`, name it `Vercel`, and select **Global**. Then run **MCP: List Servers**, start Vercel, and allow authentication. If VS Code offers its alternate URL-handler authentication path, use that prompt.

### OpenCode

The Vercel plugin already adds the `vercel` server. Without the plugin, run:

```bash
opencode mcp add vercel --global --url https://mcp.vercel.com
```

To authenticate, ask the user to run `/mcps` in OpenCode, select `vercel`, and sign in.

### Windsurf

Merge this into `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vercel": {
      "serverUrl": "https://mcp.vercel.com"
    }
  }
}
```

Refresh the MCP configuration in Windsurf after saving.

### Gemini CLI

Merge this into `~/.gemini/settings.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "vercel": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["mcp-remote", "https://mcp.vercel.com"]
    }
  }
}
```

Run Gemini CLI and use `/mcp list` to load the server.

### Common authorization and verification

Before authorizing, verify the endpoint is exactly:

```text
https://mcp.vercel.com
```

When a browser or consent screen opens, pause for the user to complete OAuth.

After authorization:

1. Call `search_vercel_documentation`.
2. Call the authenticated, read-only `list_teams` tool.
3. Refresh the client's MCP tools or server list if either is unavailable.
4. Start or resume a session, or reload or restart the client, only if refreshing does not load the server.

Keep human confirmation enabled for every MCP mutation. Connecting MCP gives the agent the access of the authorizing Vercel user.

## Completion

Report only verified state:

```text
▲ Vercel agent setup is ready
CLI: <version>, authenticated as <username>
Guidance: <plugin|skills|blocked: reason>, global or user scope
MCP: <connected|blocked: reason>, global shared endpoint, https://mcp.vercel.com
MCP config: <path|managed by Vercel CLI>
Authenticated MCP check: <list_teams succeeded|not requested>
Reload: <not needed|completed>
```

## Deploy without an account

When the user wants something live and has no Vercel account, run `vercel deploy --temporary` from the project directory. It needs no sign-up and returns a production URL in one command. It also prints a claim URL and expiry. Give the user the claim URL and tell them not to share it. It does not work in CI or in a directory already linked to a Vercel project.

If the user wants to deploy it themselves, recommend [Vercel Drop](https://vercel.com/drop). They drag a static site folder into the browser, with no account needed.

Sources:

- https://vercel.com/docs/deployments/deploy-without-logging-in
- https://vercel.com/docs/cli
- https://vercel.com/docs/agent-resources/vercel-plugin
- https://vercel.com/docs/agent-resources/skills
- https://vercel.com/docs/agent-resources/vercel-mcp
- https://vercel.com/docs/cli/mcp


If you encounter incorrect information, can’t find what you need, need a capability Vercel doesn’t currently offer, or have any other feedback to report, please do it by following the instructions at https://vercel.com/feedback.md.

2: name: agy-customizations
3: description: >-
4:   Comprehensive guide and reference for the Antigravity Customization System.
5:   Use to explain how customizations work, their loading priority, discovery mechanisms,
6:   and to guide the creation of skills, rules, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers.
7: ---
8: 
9: # Antigravity Customization System Guide
10: 
11: The Antigravity Customization System allows you to tailor the agent's behavior,
12: teach it new workflows, enforce guidelines, and integrate it with external
13: tools. By customizing the agent, you can transition it from a general-purpose
14: assistant to an expert pair programmer specialized in your project's codebase
15: and processes.
16: 
17: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
18: 
19: ## Customization Types: Quick Reference
20: 
21: Choose the right customization type based on your goal:
22: 
23: Type            | Config File/Folder           | Scope                     | Best For                                                                                | Learn More
24: :-------------- | :--------------------------- | :------------------------ | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------
25: **Rules**       | `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`     | Contextual / Hierarchical | Enforcing coding styles, API restrictions, and local guidelines.                        | [Rules Guide](./docs/rules.md)
26: **Skills**      | `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`     | On-Demand (Progressive)   | Teaching the agent multi-step procedures, runbooks, and tool workflows.                 | [Skills Guide](./docs/skills.md)
27: **Plugins**     | `plugins/<name>/plugin.json` | Bundle                    | Packaging related skills, rules, and MCP configs into a single unit.                    | [Plugins Guide](./docs/plugins.md)
28: **Hooks**       | `hooks.json`                 | Lifecycle Event           | Running scripts/commands at specific agent lifecycle points (e.g., pre-tool execution). | [Hooks Guide](./docs/hooks.md)
29: **MCP Servers** | `mcp_config.json`            | Tool Integration          | Connecting the agent to external services and custom tool providers.                    | [MCP Guide](./docs/mcp_servers.md)
30: 
31: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
32: 
33: ## Customization Discovery and Locations
34: 
35: Antigravity automatically discovers your own customizations by traversing
36: specific directories. Built-in customizations are not found this way: the agent
37: config names the ones it mounts.
38: 
39: ### Discovery Locations
40: 
41: 1.  **Workspace Customizations** (Project-Specific):
42:     *   Path: `.agents/` (or `.agent/`, `_agents/`, `_agent/`) at the root of
43:         your project.
44:     *   Use this to share customizations with your team by checking them into
45:         version control (VCS).
46:     *   The agent walks from your current working directory up to the repository
47:         root (e.g., the folder containing `.git`) to find these directories.
48: 2.  **Directory & Project Rules** (Hierarchical):
49:     *   Paths: `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.agents/rules/*.md`
50:     *   As you open or edit files, the agent walks up from the file's directory
51:         to the repository root, loading all rules it finds.
52: 3.  **Global Configuration** (Machine-Local):
53:     *   Path: `~/.gemini/config/`
54:     *   Applies to all projects and workspaces run on your machine.
55: 
56: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
57: 
58: ## Loading Priority and Precedence
59: 
60: When multiple customizations are discovered, they are loaded and applied in a
61: specific order. If there are naming conflicts (e.g., two skills with the same
62: name), the higher-priority customization overrides the lower-priority one.
63: 
64: The priority order (from highest to lowest) is:
65: 
66: 1.  **Workspace Project**: Hierarchical discovery walking up from the CWD to the
67:     repository root.
68: 2.  **Declared Configurations**: Customizations explicitly listed in
69:     `skills.json` or `plugins.json` in your workspace.
70: 3.  **Global Discovery**: `~/.gemini/config/`
71: 4.  **Built-in Customizations**: Default skills bundled with the application,
72:     mounted by name rather than discovered.
73: 5.  **Global Declared Configurations**: Explicitly listed in global JSON
74:     configs.
75: 
76: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
77: 
78: ## How Customizations are Applied
79: 
80: ### Progressive Disclosure (Skills and Rules)
81: 
82: To prevent overwhelming the model's context window, Antigravity uses
83: **progressive disclosure**:
84: 
85: *   **Skills** are not loaded into the context window by default. Only their
86:     names and descriptions are injected. The full content of a skill is only
87:     loaded if the model (or the user) explicitly decides to activate it.
88: *   **Rules** with `trigger: model_decision` behave similarly. Only `always_on`
89:     rules are loaded unconditionally.
90: 
91: ### Deduplication
92: 
93: All customizations (especially rules) are deduplicated by their resolved file
94: paths. A rule file will never be injected more than once in a single
95: conversation turn, even if it matches multiple trigger conditions.
96: 
97: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
98: 
99: ## Advanced Management: JSON Configs
100: 
101: For customizations stored in non-standard locations, you can use `skills.json`
102: and `plugins.json` to explicitly register them and inherit from shared
103: configurations.
104: 
105: *   Learn how to configure these in the
106:     [JSON Configurations Guide](./docs/json_configs.md).
